<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



First-run only: public, and refused with `409` once the server has any
account. Replaces the whole database with a scheduled backup's
`pg_dump -Fc` file (`db/famlin-<timestamp>.dump` in the backups
volume), then applies pending migrations if the dump came from an
older Famlin version. Accounts, passwords and settings come back from
the dump, so no session is issued: sign in with an existing account
afterwards. Photos are not in the dump; copy the backup's `uploads/`
mirror into the uploads volume. Rate-limited to 5 requests per 15
minutes per IP.
